note: isolationPolicyRef of profile-cpu-seg-v1 points at this file. SPEC section 3: directory separation alone is not evidence of isolation; the guard must see the actual resolved path. This policy is enforced in packages/evolver/src/domain/task-profile.ts by assertIsolationPolicy(), which resolves every candidate path to an absolute path and compares it against the roots below before any process is started.

backend.mechanism: resolved-absolute-path prefix check, with the deny list evaluated first
notClaimed: This is not an OS sandbox and not a container. It constrains which files THIS host code will read, write or hand to a child process. It does not stop an arbitrary program that is already running from touching the filesystem.

No network isolation is provided. The pinned runner imports only argparse/importlib/json/os/platform/sys/time/datetime/torch, so the run itself makes no network call, but that is a property of the pinned runner, not of this policy.

deniedPathReasons.data/sealed: sealed evaluation inputs and gold; the training side must never read them
deniedPathReasons.isolation: the isolation policy itself; a patch under test may not re-allow itself
deniedPathReasons.work/incoming: staging area for unverified human-supplied material
deniedPathReasons.configs/phase2/execution-config.json: the budget/isolation configuration table; not adaptation surface

requestCannotSupply: a timeout above the declared per-attempt budget

positiveControl.description: The policy must be demonstrably live, not a comment.
cases: a path inside readableRoots is allowed
a path inside deniedPaths is refused even when it is also under a readable root
a path outside every root is refused
a relative path that resolves outside the repository is refused
a request-supplied executable path is refused with POLICY_DENIED
